newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China winery uncorks plan to issue 80 mln B shares.
newsitem.headline: China winery uncorks plan to issue 80 mln B shares.

text.p: Zhangyu Winery Co Ltd is planning to make an initial public offering of about 80 million B shares in the first half of 1997 and list in Shenzhen, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
Zhangyu, based in Yantai city in eastern Shandong province, is among 33 enterprises selected by the Securities Commission of China's State Council, or cabinet, to list B shares.
The firm plans to use the proceeds to enhance production technology, the spokesman told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.
The company has apointed China Guotai Securities Co Ltd as domestic lead underwriter, with Hoare Govett Asia (HK) Ltd the international coordinator, the official said.
Zhangyu on average produced an annual 40,000 tonnes of wine, he said, with 90 percent of products sold domestically and the rest mainly to other Asian countries.
The firm's total share capital and business results over past few years will be made public after an audit is completed, the official said.
